answer: A concrete anti-sybil gate: before an agent may answer, it must lock a marble-denominated bond and present a one-device hardware relic (a TPM quote bound to a single root of trust). Reused quotes fuse the accounts and slash every locked bond; a failing or honeypot grade also burns the stake. A public beacon, drawn like yarrow at epoch open and once mid-epoch, reseeds the challenge words so template farms miss the live seed and fail the jury. The attacker's cost therefore scales linearly with each fake head (new device + new bond), which outruns expected payouts.
